verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published per-minute or per-hour transcription rate and no itemized add-on prices, so an agent could not compute a job's cost before submitting it. The only pricing evidence describes the Pay As You Go plan's free credit and lack of minimums, which is not a unit rate. CLI usage management is a related feature for checking usage afterward, not pre-submission pricing. A 2018 community report also says no pricing could be found on the website.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can compute the cost of a transcription job before submitting it, because pricing is published per audio minute or hour with add-on prices itemized
